articles.title: Bitcoin and USDT attract modest premiums in Paraguay as millions face banking crisis
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Bitcoin and USDT trade at premiums in Paraguay as Ueno Bank's collapse triggers a currency crisis and rising interest in crypto.
- The dollar has surged 10% against the guaraní, while nearly 3 million bank customers face uncertainty over their savings.
- Crypto executives are pushing Bitcoin as an alternative, but whether rising interest translates into sustained adoption remains unclear.
Bitcoin and USDT have traded at premiums in Paraguay's peer-to-peer markets as a banking collapse unsettles the country's financial system.
The turmoil has coincided with a 10% surge in the dollar against the Paraguayan guaraní, growing public interest in Bitcoin and calls from crypto executives for alternatives to traditional banking.
Data from CriptoNoticias, which tracks Binance P2P prices, showed Bitcoin's indicative buying price at 498 million guaraníes on Nov. 6. Using an exchange rate of approximately 6,469 guaraníes per dollar, this is equivalent to $76,982.53 and represents a premium of roughly 1.7% over the international Bitcoin price of $75,716.
A review of Binance P2P advertisements on Nov. 5 found a median buying price of 6,399 guaraníes for USDT, about 4% above the previous day's central bank dollar reference rate. The gap narrowed sharply as the official exchange rate caught up with the currency's depreciation.
Meanwhile, Google Trends data showed rising interest in Bitcoin and the dollar across Paraguay.
Searches for Bitcoin began trending upward on Oct. 23 and peaked on Oct. 30, before the formal announcement of Ueno Bank's closure. Interest remained evident as of press time, while searches for the US dollar also increased amid the financial uncertainty.
The developments suggest growing public attention to alternative assets as the country's banking and currency markets face mounting pressure.
Ueno Bank collapse triggers currency selloff and political crisis
Paraguay's central bank initiated resolution proceedings against Ueno Bank on Nov. 2 after determining that the lender's solvency ratio had fallen below half the legal minimum.
The decision disrupted access to deposits for customers of the digital lender, which served nearly 3 million people, and raised concerns about approximately $850 million in public-sector deposits, including pension and healthcare funds.
The financial disruption quickly spread to the foreign-exchange market.
According to local media outlet ABC Color, the retail selling price of the dollar climbed from 5,900 guaraníes on Oct. 30 to 6,500 on Nov. 5, representing an appreciation of approximately 10.2%.
The currency movement coincided with growing scrutiny of President Santiago Peña, who previously held a stake in Grupo Vázquez, the business group controlling Ueno Bank.
Peña has denied wrongdoing and maintained that he sold his investment in March 2025. He offered his resignation on Nov. 5, but lawmakers continued impeachment proceedings the following day.
In a public statement, Peña pledged to cooperate with investigators while urging authorities to prioritize payments to affected depositors.
He added:
“Payment to savers cannot be left pending on what happens to me…My priority was to push, within the law and in coordination with the responsible institutions, the measures needed for savers to recover their savings. Clarifying the facts and resolving the payments are obligations that must move forward at the same time. One cannot be an excuse to postpone the other.”
The central bank has since initiated payments through Paraguay's deposit-guarantee framework, starting with eligible customers holding up to 10 million guaraníes.
Crypto executives promote Bitcoin as an alternative to traditional banking
The crisis has prompted several prominent crypto industry executives to argue that decentralized assets could reduce savers' exposure to banking failures.
Emin Gün Sirer, founder of Avalanche developer Ava Labs, said the developments demonstrated the benefits of cryptocurrencies like BTC, which are held outside conventional financial institutions. He wrote on X:
“[Crypto] assets such as AVAX and BTC are decentralized and require no trust in third parties. No one can take or freeze your AVAX [or BTC] without your consent.”
Samson Mow, CEO of Bitcoin adoption firm JAN3, made a similar argument, suggesting that governments could reduce the disruption caused by banking crises by establishing Bitcoin as an alternative financial network.
He said:
“Bitcoin adoption at a nation-state level can mitigate these types of situations. If BTC is available to the people as a parallel rail, then systemic banking failures have far less impact.”
Mow also said JAN3 met with Paraguay's central bank several years earlier to discuss Bitcoin adoption and the risks of conventional financial infrastructure.
Aave founder and CEO Stani Kulechov joined the discussion, declaring that “Bitcoin matters now more than ever” in reference to Paraguay.
Their comments reflect growing industry efforts to position cryptocurrencies as alternatives during financial crises, particularly in countries facing banking restrictions and currency instability.
However, the market's next test will be whether local Bitcoin and stablecoin activity remains elevated as Paraguay's authorities return deposits and attempt to restore confidence in the banking system.

articles.title: Chainalysis Reveals Wider Data Exposure After Cyberattack
articles.text:
Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.
Chainalysis on Wednesday disclosed a wider impact from a cyberattack it initially described as involving only non-sensitive customer information.
“On Monday, we discovered certain customer information including names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all Chainalysis users were exposed to a malicious actor,” the blockchain analytics firm said in an update to its incident notice.
The company did not disclose whether each type of information was exposed for every user and declined to provide Cointelegraph with additional information beyond its published disclosure.
Chainalysis initially said on Oct. 30 that the intrusion exposed user IDs, names and email addresses but found no evidence that attackers accessed authentication credentials or session tokens.
Another Wednesday update stated an “on-path attack” exposed some customers’ passwords. The company said it had contained and remediated that attack vector and was locking affected accounts and requiring password resets.
Despite the broader exposure, Chainalysis said it still had no evidence that attackers accessed investigation data or manipulated its attribution data.
Related: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex

articles.title: Crypto Exchanges Tout Cold Storage After Binance Hack
articles.text:
Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.
Crypto exchanges were quick to reassure users following the attack on Binance’s hot wallet infrastructure last week, with several companies disclosing how they divide assets between cold storage and internet-connected hot wallets this week.
Crypto exchange Gate on Thursday launched a “Proof of Security” (PoSEC) framework, reporting that 88.26% of its total assets were in cold storage and 11.74% in hot wallets. It claims its cold storage could cover 104.58% of customer assets even if its hot wallets were completely drained.
“By publicly disclosing the distribution of assets between platform cold storage and hot wallets, PoSEC provides visibility into asset storage structures and their ability to cover potential losses under extreme scenarios,” Gate said. It noted the data is still undergoing independent review by a third-party audit firm.
Threat actors attacked Binance’s hot-wallet infrastructure last week, stealing approximately $6.36 billion, most of it in about 20 minutes, according to TRM Labs. Binance CEO Richard Teng said the “vast majority” of user assets are held in cold wallets, but the company has not provided a precise split.
Other crypto exchanges have been quick to share their cold storage ratios this week.
Coinbase says 99% of customer assets held in cold wallets
In a blog post Wednesday, Coinbase said that more than 99% of customer assets are held in offline cold storage and that it continuously rebalances excess assets to cold storage.
“Binance’s reported hot wallet incident has understandably left customers asking how Coinbase protects customer assets from something similar happening here,” it said.
On Tuesday, Upbit, the largest cryptocurrency exchange in South Korea, confirmed it holds 99.17% of its assets in cold wallets, with the remaining 0.83% in hot wallets as of September 2026. These figures are already disclosed to the Financial Supervisory Service.
“This represents the highest cold wallet storage ratio among South Korea’s five major KRW-based cryptocurrency exchanges and is substantially above the regulatory minimum of 80%,” a spokesperson for Upbit parent company Dunamu told Cointelegraph, in response to questions about South Korea’s call for crypto exchanges to increase their cold storage ratios.
“Our aim is to keep our hot wallet holdings at an absolute minimum, with a target of maintaining them below 1% of customer digital assets,” they added.
Related: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
Other major South Korean exchanges have reported lower cold-wallet shares. Financial Supervisory Service figures cited in earlier reporting put Bithumb at 94.76%, Coinone at 85%, Digital X, formerly Korbit, at 82.79%, and GOPAX at 80.54% at the end of September.
OKX’s existing security overview, last updated on Sept. 18, 2026, said it holds more than 95% of client crypto assets in cold wallets and less than 5% in hot wallets.
The reported ratios are not necessarily directly comparable because exchanges use different reporting periods and may calculate cold-storage shares against different asset bases.
Cold storage ratios, however, offer only part of the picture of an exchange’s security.
Offline wallets can still be exposed through compromised signing systems, inadequate access controls or employees approving fraudulent transactions.
Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission warned in an August 2025 circular that such weaknesses could compromise both hot- and cold-wallet infrastructure.
Magazine: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express

articles.title: Ardoino’s 24/7 asset plan depends on buyers willing to wait for cash
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Tether’s Hadron agreement gives issuers access to RedStone pricing feeds and an auction-based settlement service for eligible assets.
- Approved buyers advance immediate funds, take the tokens and finance the wait for redemption through the issuer’s native process.
- RedStone’s Hadron release places near-instant holder exits on the roadmap, with asset-level deployment and committed liquidity unspecified.
Tether’s plan to make tokenized assets liquid around the clock relies on buyers willing to advance cash before the underlying investment pays out. Its November 5 agreement with data and settlement provider RedStone gives issuers on Hadron, Tether’s tokenization platform, access to price feeds, net asset value data and an auction-based settlement service for eligible assets. Tether announcement
Paolo Ardoino, Tether’s CEO, framed the collaboration around accurate pricing and continuous liquidity. RedStone’s settlement service, Settle, proposes to bridge the timing gap by having approved liquidity providers take over positions, pay immediately and collect through the issuer’s ordinary redemption process. The buyer finances the wait, making its willingness to submit an auction offer central to faster exits. RedStone’s announcement places near-instant voluntary holder redemptions on the roadmap. RedStone’s Hadron announcement
Hadron’s earlier rollout focused on issuing and managing tokenized assets with compliance tools, as CryptoSlate reported in November 2024. This agreement adds access to valuation and settlement infrastructure that could make those assets more useful as lending collateral. Earlier Hadron coverage
Who pays for the wait
A lender liquidating collateral needs funds to close a borrowing position. A tokenized investment can carry a redemption timetable that extends beyond the moment the lender needs payment. Settle connects that position with approved buyers, also called solvers, that can supply liquid funds and acquire the tokens.
In the model described in RedStone’s April product explanation, a solver buys at a discount and seeks to earn the spread to face value at maturity. Actual redemption proceeds depend on the asset’s terms. The buyer’s financing costs and expected payout shape the price it can offer for taking over the redemption wait. Settle’s funding model
RedStone lists several possible funding strategies, including liquid restaking capital, on-demand stablecoin minting, institutional over-the-counter desks and dedicated settlement vaults. The Hadron announcement leaves the committed capacity of its prospective liquidity providers unspecified.
For lenders, a successful auction turns collateral into repayment funds immediately. For the winning buyer, it creates an investment that still has to complete the issuer’s redemption process. The discount is therefore part of the cost of delivering speed to the exiting side of the trade.
Independent documentation from Centrifuge illustrates the distinction. Its investor guide says redemption requests are processed at the manager’s cadence, with the final amount determined by the processing price. Freely transferable tokens can instead be sold at market prices where secondary liquidity is available. Centrifuge investor guide
RedStone describes a proposed voluntary-exit route in which holders set their maximum acceptable haircut and providers quote to buy the position. Large positions can be divided among several providers. RedStone’s Hadron announcement
The same announcement describes near-instant unwinding of leveraged, looped positions as a design capability. In such a position, an investor borrows against tokens, buys more tokens and posts those as collateral again. The release provides no Hadron-specific activation schedule for that unwind feature.
The limits of available liquidity
Participation also has boundaries. Providers complete RedStone’s business verification and must satisfy the issuer’s holder requirements, including identity checks or whitelisting. The announcement’s access disclosure excludes persons located, resident or incorporated in the United States.
Settle’s architecture selects the highest valid offer and executes the price update, solver callback, loan repayment and collateral release in one transaction. A failure in that sequence causes the transaction to revert in full. Settle architecture
Buyer availability determines whether that exchange can happen on acceptable terms. In its September explanation of Settle for the HYB tokenized bond fund, RedStone says an auction receiving no offers reverts and liquidation proceeds through the regular route. HYB settlement example
For Hadron issuers, the reviewed announcements and architecture disclose no committed liquidity amount, guaranteed auction coverage or executed settlement volume.
If eligible buyers lack available capital or demand a larger discount than an exiting holder accepts, fast settlement can become harder to obtain. The practical test for Ardoino’s round-the-clock ambition is whether the rollout attracts approved providers willing to offer prices that lenders and eligible holders can use.

articles.title: Core Scientific to Exit Bitcoin Mining in 2026
articles.text:
Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.
Core Scientific said it expects to exit Bitcoin mining by the end of 2026 as it shifts its business toward artificial intelligence and high-performance computing infrastructure.
“We expect to complete the wind-down during the fourth quarter and enter 2027 as a pure-play, high-density colocation provider,” said Core Scientific chief financial officer Jim Nygaard during a Q3 earnings call on Thursday.
Core Scientific had previously disclosed in a July quarterly filing that hosted mining would end by Dec. 31 as it continued to wind down its self-mining operations. The comment establishes a targeted completion date for its complete Bitcoin mining exit.
Its latest quarterly results show how far the business has shifted. Third-quarter self-mining revenue fell to $12.3 million from $57.4 million a year earlier, while revenue from hosting other miners dropped to $5.2 million from $8.7 million.
Bitcoin mining generated just $17.5 million, or 7.5%, of Core Scientific’s $232.9 million in third-quarter revenue, compared with $215.4 million from colocation services.
The company had nearly 50% fewer miners online at the end of September than at the end of 2025, according to Nygaard.
Core Scientific pivot to AI
Core Scientific’s move into AI hosting took shape in 2024 after signing an initial hosting agreement with CoreWeave in March that year, followed by a much larger deal announced in June.
At the time, Core Scientific presented AI hosting as an expansion alongside its mining business. Its June 2024 announcement emphasized preserving Bitcoin mining capacity.
By December 2025, The Wall Street Journal reported that Core Scientific was already targeting to wind down its Bitcoin mining operations by 2028.
Related: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
Mining economics added pressure in the months following.
Core Scientific recorded $266.5 million in mining-related asset impairments in the first quarter of 2026, citing weaker Bitcoin prices, historically low hashprice and falling digital asset mining equipment values in the secondary market.
During the second quarter, it terminated its mining equipment agreement with Block and Proto, recording a $41.9 million loss as part of the transition.
US midterms bring scrutiny of data-center growth
The planned exit comes as the US election results introduce fresh uncertainty for companies expanding AI infrastructure.
Opponents of data-center development were among the winners of the Democrats’ sweeping midterm gains, Reuters reported Wednesday.
The backlash centers partly on electricity bills and the demands large facilities place on local resources.
Cointelegraph reached out to Core Scientific for comment.
Magazine: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?

articles.title: AI watchdog report indicates we may have less than 6 months before AI super intelligence arrives
articles.text:
Quick Take
- METR judges Anthropic's October 2026 progress on well-specified tasks roughly twice its historical pace, with substantial uncertainty.
- The separate benchmark fit estimates 1.9x faster growth, including unreleased models, with a 95% confidence interval of 1.5x–2.8x.
- Anthropic redacted key causal evidence; AP reports McCandlish defended withholding details on commercial and safety grounds.
Anthropic's AI models were likely improving on tasks with clear success criteria roughly twice as fast in October 2026 as they did between March 2024 and October 2025, according to a Nov. 5 assessment by METR, an independent model-evaluation group.
METR judges that AI assistance probably accounts for most of the recent acceleration. But Anthropic redacted much of the evidence behind that judgment, leaving outsiders with a clearer view of the faster benchmark trend than of what caused it.
Anthropic's benchmark trend and AI's role
The central published measurement uses AECI, Anthropic's version of the Epoch Capabilities Index. METR estimated that AECI's fitted growth rate after October 2025 was 1.9 times its earlier rate, with a 95% confidence interval of 1.5 to 2.8 times. The analysis includes snapshots of unreleased models, so it covers more than the products customers could access.
METR interprets that trend as roughly two years of historical benchmark progress achieved in the past year. The 1.9-times fit is distinct from its broader judgment of roughly twice the historical pace on well-specified tasks. That judgment carries substantial uncertainty, including whether the same acceleration extends to broader work.
Those limits matter because success on clean, easily graded tasks may translate unevenly into real-world usefulness. METR also cautions that an unusually slow historical baseline could make the acceleration appear larger. In the other direction, model results arrive after training, potentially concealing a more recent change in research speed.
METR says it confidently ruled out an acceleration in the growth of training compute as the explanation for the faster progress. The detailed evidence supporting that finding was redacted.
Beyond that exclusion, separating causes was less decisive. METR says non-AI factors likely played a significant role in the acceleration in late 2025, while judging that AI assistance now accounts for a majority of it.
The distinction also leaves people at the center of the most important training work. METR says AI was not yet making highly significant, fully autonomous contributions to those parts of Anthropic's model-training process. The reported speedup primarily involved researchers using AI assistance.
What remains behind the redactions
Anthropic withheld a majority of the evidence METR found most informative for its risk conclusions. The redactions covered detailed estimates of acceleration and AI's contribution at different training stages, intermediate capability measurements, algorithmic-progress estimates, R&D inputs, bottleneck analyses and forecasts. Some interview and AI-contribution evidence was published, leaving readers able to inspect only part of the case behind METR's judgment.
Anthropic co-founder Sam McCandlish broadly agreed that AI was speeding research, according to The Associated Press. AP reported that he acknowledged the redactions made METR's work harder to check, while defending them because the details were commercially sensitive and could help other developers accelerate.
METR's companion review of Anthropic's August Risk Report, also published Nov. 5, addresses models available on July 15. It questions the confidence of the public report's argument that an early-warning acceleration threshold had not been crossed. That threshold concerns AI-driven research acceleration as a warning signal, rather than proof that catastrophic risks have materialized.
Researchers at both organizations still leaned toward the threshold remaining uncrossed then, while METR considered a crossing plausible. METR also agreed that direct catastrophic risks from those July models were low.
The main assessment ran from Aug. 12 to Oct. 29 and was separate from the employee-like evaluator program Anthropic announced Oct. 15. For public scrutiny, the unresolved gap is specific: the faster benchmark trend is described, but much of the evidence dividing that progress between AI assistance and other causes remains confidential.
At the pace METR measured, six months could deliver roughly a year’s worth of progress on Anthropic’s benchmarks. The case for superintelligence within that window hinges on what the next models can do with those gains. If they can design training experiments, spot promising results, and help turn them into better models, each generation could shorten the time it takes to build the next.
For that to produce superintelligence within six months, the gains would have to carry over from tasks with clear answers to open-ended work where even experts have to figure out what to try next. The first sign might come from inside an AI lab, when a model runs an experiment its researchers hadn’t thought to try, and the result helps build a more capable successor.

articles.title: Greece ends years of crypto tax uncertainty with new 10% levy on Bitcoin profits
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Greece approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains, with annual profits up to €500 exempt and separate rules proposed for staking and DeFi income.
- The framework introduces a proposed 15% levy on DeFi earnings and allows qualifying crypto losses to offset future profits.
- Authorities face challenges tracking investors using overseas exchanges, with new transparency and audit rules expected in the coming weeks.
Greece has approved a 10% cryptocurrency capital gains tax and a separate 15% levy on staking and decentralized finance (DeFi) income.
The legislation, passed by parliament on Nov. 5, establishes the country's first comprehensive framework for taxing digital assets, with the new rules scheduled to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027.
According to Reuters, annual cryptocurrency gains of up to €500 will be exempt, while investors exceeding that threshold will face taxation on their profits.
The framework also allows qualifying losses to be carried forward for five years to offset future gains.
Under the finance ministry's October proposal, staking, lending and DeFi liquidity rewards would attract a 15% tax as interest income, separating those earnings from trading profits.
The ministry also proposed exempting crypto-to-crypto swaps from immediate taxation, although parliamentary concerns about the final wording leave their treatment unresolved.
Meanwhile, the legislation provides a 12-month window for investors to voluntarily declare cryptocurrency gains from previous years without late-filing penalties or interest, subject to specified conditions.
The measure comes as Greek authorities struggle to monitor cryptocurrency activity conducted through overseas platforms.
A senior finance ministry official reportedly said that the government could not estimate potential tax revenue because most domestic investors use foreign exchanges, making the market difficult to measure.
Further directives covering transparency requirements and tax audits are expected in the coming weeks.
Greece joins Europe's widening crypto tax divide
Greece's new rate places it among Europe's lower-tax jurisdictions for cryptocurrency investors, even as several countries have increased taxes on digital asset profits.
According to a Nov. 6 analysis by CryptoDiffer, Cyprus taxes crypto gains at 8%, while Belgium and Bulgaria apply 10% rates and Croatia charges 12%.
Other European countries have moved in the opposite direction.
Italy increased its standard cryptocurrency capital-gains tax to 33% in 2026, while Romania raised its rate to 16%. Sweden imposes a 30% capital-gains tax on qualifying crypto profits.
However, some European jurisdictions offer investors exemptions based on how long they hold their assets.
CryptoDiffer identified Germany and Portugal as exempting qualifying cryptocurrency gains after one year of holding, while Luxembourg applies a six-month threshold. Croatia offers an exemption after two years and Czechia after three.
Switzerland, Slovenia and Malta were also identified as jurisdictions where qualifying private-investor crypto gains can be exempt from capital-gains tax.
These differences reflect Europe's fragmented approach to crypto taxation, with investors facing substantially different liabilities depending on their country, holding period and classification of investment activity.

articles.title: Ethereum software bug triggers emergency fixes across major layer-2 networks
articles.text:
Quick Take
- A critical Reth software bug prompted emergency patches across Ethereum infrastructure, including Base, Optimism and Tempo.
- Paradigm warned that crafted transactions could produce incorrect blockchain state calculations, potentially disrupting networks using shared software.
- Developers confirmed L2 withdrawals were unaffected, but node operators must install patches as LayerZero temporarily restricts some cross-chain routes.
A software flaw that could allow specially crafted transactions to produce incorrect blockchain state calculations has prompted coordinated fixes across Ethereum infrastructure.
On Nov. 5, Georgios Konstantopoulos, chief technology officer at crypto investment firm Paradigm, said that developers had released patches for Reth, Optimism, Base and Tempo after discovering an error in software used to process blockchain transactions.
The vulnerability affected Reth, an Ethereum execution client developed by Paradigm that provides critical infrastructure for networks operating within the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) ecosystem.
The Reth bug
According to Konstantopoulos, the flaw originated in Reth's legacy state-root calculation system, which could return an incorrect result when processing certain smart contract storage configurations.
A state root is a cryptographic fingerprint representing a blockchain's current state, including account balances and smart contract data. An incorrect calculation can cause nodes to disagree about the validity of a block, potentially disrupting transaction processing or network synchronization.
“Reth's legacy state root code had an edge case,” Konstantopoulos explained, adding that a carefully crafted transaction could trigger the error under specific conditions.
Reth's block-building software used the vulnerable calculation method on lower-end hardware and in networks built with Optimism's OP Stack, extending the potential exposure beyond Ethereum's mainnet infrastructure.
The Tempo development team discovered the issue through automated security testing. The testing technique, known as fuzzing, involves feeding software unusual or unexpected inputs to uncover errors that ordinary testing might miss.
Konstantopoulos said Tempo had also been patched, while Reth developers released version 2.10.0, Optimism published OP Reth v2.8.1, and Base issued version 1.5.3.
The Reth release classified the update as high priority for node operators, including those responsible for building blocks.
The coordinated response highlights a vulnerability in Ethereum's increasingly interconnected software ecosystem: multiple blockchain networks can inherit the same underlying defect when they rely on shared execution software.
However, Konstantopoulos said the affected code did not expose users of Base and other OP Stack networks to faulty withdrawals.
He explained that these networks' withdrawal systems were not vulnerable to the error, while ecosystem bridges generally rely on transaction receipt roots or multisignature authorization rather than the affected state-root calculations.
He also apologized for the disruption, emphasizing Paradigm's responsibility for maintaining infrastructure used across the Ethereum ecosystem.
Base confirms user funds safe as LayerZero restricts cross-chain activity
Base separately confirmed that the vulnerability had not affected its users, providing additional details about how its security systems prevented the error from threatening the network's integrity.
In a Nov. 5 status update, the Coinbase-backed network said it discovered the Reth issue on Nov. 4 and immediately patched its block builders.
The team also independently recalculated the blockchain's state root to verify its accuracy.
Base said its proof system uses a separate implementation to verify state roots, providing an additional check capable of detecting discrepancies in calculations produced by Reth.
The network said:
“We've verified the current state root is correct and users were not affected.”
The version 1.5.3 release also addresses a separate operational consequence of the defect, preventing Base validators from halting when encountering invalid state roots.
Node operators were encouraged to upgrade, although Base said they would not need to resynchronize their nodes or take additional recovery steps.
Nevertheless, concerns about the software flaw prompted precautionary measures across parts of the decentralized finance ecosystem.
Frax Finance reported on Nov. 5 that cross-chain messaging protocol LayerZero had temporarily suspended certain transfer routes while developers assessed the situation.
Frax said its assets and smart contracts continued operating normally and that user funds remained safe.
The restrictions did not establish that LayerZero's bridge contracts were vulnerable to the Reth defect. Instead, they demonstrated how concerns about shared blockchain infrastructure can prompt other services to restrict activity while assessing operational risks.
There were no confirmed reports of funds being stolen through the state-root calculation flaw.
Konstantopoulos said the coordinated patching effort had secured Reth-based infrastructure, including systems that depend on blockchain state proofs.
However, the availability of corrected software does not mean every independently operated node has installed it.
The remaining priority is for infrastructure providers and node operators to deploy the patched releases, while services that restricted activity determine when they can resume normal operations.

articles.title: Bitcoin miner IREN’s AI revenue milestone slips into 2027 as expansion seeks $6 billion
articles.text:
Quick Take
- IREN’s September 30 plan pairs $15 billion of remaining FY27 capex with $9 billion in cash and committed sources.
- Funding covers the initial 0.3GW AI program, subject to draw conditions; the wider September 30 plan targets $6 billion still to fund.
- IREN’s operating AI run-rate target moved to Jan. 31, 2027, possibly end-February; revenue ramps after commissioning, testing and customer acceptance.
Bitcoin miner IREN has moved its AI operating-revenue milestone from December 31, 2026, to January 31, 2027, potentially extending through the end of February. The target of more than $4 billion is an annualized operating measure, not recognized annual revenue. Its November 5 results also identify a separate $6 billion financing target for wider expansion beyond the conditionally funded initial program. IREN’s quarterly results
Management defines funding coverage around an initial 0.3GW of IT capacity. Its broader plan includes $15 billion of remaining FY27 data-center and GPU spending, measured from September 30.
What IREN’s AI financing covers
IREN’s earnings presentation divides that remaining spending into $5.8 billion of cash, including restricted cash, $3.2 billion of committed funding and $6 billion still to fund. The first two categories make up the $9 billion bucket cited in its results. All three figures use the September 30 baseline. Quarterly earnings presentation
The $9 billion includes undrawn GPU financing facilities and contracted customer prepayments still to be received. Facility conditions, the release of escrowed proceeds and availability periods govern access to the committed financing.
IREN applies its “fully funded” description to the remaining data-center and GPU costs of the 0.3GW program supporting the revenue target.
The separate $6 billion target covers GPU financing, customer prepayments, data-center financing and corporate sources. Those sources remain subject to market conditions and existing debt terms. The $6 billion concerns planned expenditure over the remaining fiscal year. IREN links that spending to future capacity targets, which include 0.8GW by the end of calendar 2027. Funding scope and conditions
Procurement is already advancing beyond the initial program. IREN’s presentation says GPUs have been ordered for an additional 0.3GW, while management retains flexibility to pace expansion toward its capacity targets. Capacity expansion plan
Customer cash can reduce the amount IREN must finance. A five-year contract signed after September 30 carries estimated annual revenue of about $22 million per IT megawatt and contracted prepayments covering 90% of its associated estimated GPU capex. That coverage is specific to the contract’s GPU costs, with prepayment terms varying across customers. The deal belongs to the post-quarter period, separate from the September funding snapshot. Post-quarter contract disclosure
Earlier transactions illustrate how financing can follow physical deployment. Blue Owl Capital’s August announcement described the $2.4 billion Mackenzie equipment facility as a $1.2 billion senior secured loan and $1.2 billion of senior secured notes, with purchases funded in tranches alongside hardware delivery and commissioning. Blue Owl’s financing announcement
Cost also varies across facilities. IREN’s August results put Microsoft-related GPU financing at a 6% weighted-average rate excluding fees, while the Mackenzie financing carried a 9% fixed rate. IREN’s August results
The funded milestone has moved
Management attributes the revised January-to-February operating timetable to a customer-requested design change and supplier timing. Revised operating timetable
Annualized-run-rate revenue, or ARR, projects a year of revenue from contracted GPU hourly pricing, plus storage and ancillary revenue, using pricing and utilization assumptions. Recognized revenue can be materially lower. Commissioning, testing and customer acceptance determine when deployments begin contributing to the revenue ramp.
The September quarter shows how far the revenue mix has already shifted. IREN reported $228 million of total revenue, comprising $135 million from AI Cloud Services, $65 million from AI Cloud Lease and $28 million from Bitcoin mining. Combined AI revenue rose from a rounded $71 million in the June quarter to $200 million. June’s comparative consisted entirely of AI Cloud Services, with nil lease revenue. Revenue breakdown

articles.title: Binance cuts off trading platform SignalPlus after hackers break in with a fake Teams invite
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Binance says it removed all SignalPlus-linked API keys and told affected users to review positions and open orders directly.
- Deribit said connected-key revocation stopped trading, monitoring and automation through SignalPlus, while users could check accounts directly.
- SignalPlus reported losses below $82,000, said reimbursement had begun and pledged to repay all affected users in full.
Binance cut its connections with crypto trading platform SignalPlus on Nov. 5 after a security warning. SignalPlus later said attackers had broken into its network after an engineer was tricked with a fake Microsoft Teams meeting invitation.
API keys let software access an exchange account within the permissions a user grants. In its advisory, Binance described the revocation as an immediate precaution and said its own systems were unaffected and user funds remained safe.
Deribit later issued its own notice. Deribit said it had revoked all customer API keys connected to SignalPlus, stopping trading, monitoring and automation through that connection. It said Deribit's systems and data were unaffected, and directed users to check their accounts on Deribit itself.
SignalPlus subsequently described an attack it had detected in the early hours of Nov. 4. In a statement, SignalPlus put losses below $82,000 in its assessment to date and said it had begun reimbursing affected users.
Binance told SignalPlus users to check both positions and open orders through its own platform. Binance recommended waiting until SignalPlus confirms full resolution before reconnecting API keys, and enabling IP whitelisting.
Deribit's guidance covered open orders, positions and recent account activity. @DeribitOfficial also recommended IP allowlisting and waiting for official communication from SignalPlus before reconnecting. Its notice described the interruption to functions through SignalPlus, while directing users to manage their accounts through the exchange.
The advice extended beyond those two exchanges. In a post responding to Binance's advisory, Changpeng Zhao urged people using SignalPlus on other exchange platforms to revoke their API keys and advised against storing keys with third-party platforms.
Binance also called on third-party platforms integrated with it to review their security controls, monitor unusual activity and contact the exchange immediately if they detected concerns.
How the SignalPlus attack reached exchange API keys
SignalPlus said its investigation traced the incident to a compromised Telegram account belonging to a contact at a third-party technology vendor. According to the company, the attacker impersonated that contact and sent an engineer a fake Microsoft Teams meeting invitation that compromised the engineer's computer.
SignalPlus said it detected the attack in the early hours of Nov. 4 and contained the intrusion. SignalPlus said it contacted partner exchanges to disable every user API key associated with its platform and suspended services for a comprehensive security review.
The company said full reimbursement had begun on a case-by-case basis and pledged to repay all affected users.
Binance's Spot API documentation separates permission to place and cancel orders from permission to view private account information, such as order status and trading history. Trading permission must be enabled explicitly. Binance gives the example of one key for trading and another for monitoring order status.
IP allowlisting adds a separate restriction. Binance Academy's guidance explains that, when IP restrictions are enabled, requests from addresses outside the key's whitelist are rejected.
SignalPlus acknowledged that it had not previously made IP whitelisting mandatory for exchange API access. It said it would tighten API access requirements and strengthen endpoint security, internal access controls and key management as part of its response.
SignalPlus said services would return in phases after its review, necessary patches and confirmation that restoration was safe. Its statement supplied no fixed reopening date.

articles.title: What Is INJC? A Guide to the Canary Staked INJ ETF | CoinGecko
articles.text:
This article is brought to you by Injective.
The Canary Staked INJ ETF (ticker: INJC) began trading on November 5, 2026, aiming to give U.S. investors a way to hold INJ, the native asset of Injective, through an ordinary brokerage account. The fund holds spot INJ and stakes most of it, so staking rewards build up inside the fund instead of being paid out to shareholders.
If you have wanted INJ in your portfolio but haven’t set up a crypto wallet, INJC is designed for you. This guide explains what the fund is, why it matters for Injective, how staking rewards grow your holding, how to buy shares and the risks to know.
Key Takeaways
- INJC is a spot INJ ETF sponsored by Canary Capital, listed on Nasdaq, and the first U.S.-listed ETF to hold INJ.
- Under normal conditions the fund intends to stake at least 90% of its INJ through third-party staking providers, with BitGo Bank & Trust holding the keys.
- Staking rewards are added back into the fund, so each share grows over time. There are no cash payouts.
- Shares trade in U.S. dollars during market hours, while INJ itself trades around the clock.
- INJC holders get INJ price exposure plus staking without managing wallets or validators, but they cannot vote in Injective governance or use their shares in onchain applications.
Why an INJ ETF Matters
An ETF lets people invest in INJ the same way they buy a stock, through the brokerage they already use. Before INJC, owning INJ meant opening a crypto exchange account or setting up a wallet, and staking it meant choosing a validator and managing the process yourself. INJC puts both steps behind one ticker.
That opens INJ to a much wider group of people. Many investors, financial advisors and institutions can only buy assets that trade on a regulated U.S. exchange and sit with a qualified custodian. For them, an ETF is often the only practical way to hold a crypto asset at all. With INJC, INJ joins a very short list. Before this launch, only about 15 digital assets had a U.S. spot ETF, including bitcoin, ether, Ripple, Solana and Chainlink. Out of the tens of thousands of tokens tracked on CoinGecko, INJ is now one of roughly 16 that U.S. investors can buy through a spot ETF.
The launch also fits where Injective has been heading. Injective is a blockchain purpose-built for finance, and much of its recent work has focused on connecting onchain markets with the regulated financial system.
| Date | Milestone | 
| November 2026 | INJC, the first U.S.-listed INJ ETF, begins trading on Nasdaq | 
| August 2026 | Injective Institutional Services becomes an SEC-registered transfer agent, able to keep official ownership records for tokenized securities | 
| July 2026 | Injective publishes its MiCA whitepaper, supporting regulated INJ offerings across the European Union | 
| April 2026 | U.S.-regulated INJ futures begin trading on Bitnomial, a CFTC-regulated exchange | 
Each of these steps makes Injective easier for traditional institutions to build on and INJ easier for traditional investors to own. INJC is the one most people will notice first, because it puts INJ in the same account as the rest of their portfolio.
INJC at a Glance
INJC holds INJ itself, so its value follows the price of INJ.
| Detail | INJC | 
| Full name | Canary Staked INJ ETF | 
| Ticker | INJC | 
| Listing exchange | Nasdaq | 
| Launch date | November 5, 2026 | 
| Sponsor | Canary Capital Group LLC | 
| Underlying asset | Spot INJ | 
| Staking target | At least 90% of the fund's INJ under normal conditions | 
| INJ custodian | BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. | 
Source: Canary Staked INJ ETF Form S-1/A, October 23, 2026; final terms in the INJC prospectus.
How Staking Works Inside INJC
INJC aims to stake on your behalf. Most of the fund's INJ is staked with validators, the operators who keep the Injective network running. The rewards it earns are added back into the fund, so each share represents a little more INJ over time. If you want out, you simply sell your shares.
What staking rewards look like
Staking INJ has recently paid roughly 7% a year, according to the Injective Hub. The rate depends on how much INJ is staked across the network, so it can rise or fall over time and is not guaranteed.
Because INJC restakes its rewards, they compound. Here is a hypothetical example of a holding backed by 100 INJ, assuming the reward rate holds steady at 7% a year:
| Time held | INJ behind the holding | 
| At purchase | 100.0 | 
| 1 year | 107.0 | 
| 3 years | 122.5 | 
| 5 years | 140.3 | 
This example is for illustration only, leaves out fund expenses, and is not a forecast of INJC's returns.
The dollar value of that holding still depends on the price of INJ, which can move up or down by much more than staking adds.
What Is Injective?
Injective is a blockchain built for finance. Applications on Injective let people & agents trade crypto, (public & Pre-IPO) stocks, commodities and FX onchain. Companies such as Pentiv or POSCO International use it to bring real-world assets like mortgage records or trade receivables, respectively, onto the blockchain. INJ is the network's native asset, and INJC's value follows its price.
INJ has three main jobs on the network:
- Fees: transactions on Injective are paid in INJ.
- Security: staked INJ helps secure the network, which is where INJC's staking rewards come from.
- Governance: staked INJ votes on upgrades and changes to the network.
Injective also runs a monthly Community BuyBack. Participants commit INJ in exchange for a share of ecosystem revenue, and the committed INJ is burned.
INJC vs. Holding INJ Directly
INJC and INJ both give exposure to the same asset, but they live in different accounts and come with different rights.
|  | INJC (ETF shares) | INJ (the token) | 
| Where you hold it | Brokerage account | Crypto wallet or exchange account | 
| Who holds the keys | BitGo, as the fund's custodian | You or your exchange | 
| Staking | The fund stakes for you | You choose a validator and stake | 
| Exiting a staked position | Sell shares on the exchange | Wait 21 days to unstake | 
| Trading hours | Weekdays during U.S. market hours | 24/7 on crypto exchanges (decentralized & centralized) | 
| Governance voting | No | Yes, with staked INJ | 
| Use in onchain apps and the BuyBack | No | Yes | 
| Retirement accounts | Possible, depending on the broker | Only through specialized crypto IRA providers | 
Source: Injective, "INJ Tokens and INJ ETF Shares Compared" and the INJC prospectus.
INJC is built for investors who want INJ and its staking rewards inside the same account as their stocks and other ETFs, without managing a wallet or picking validators. Direct INJ ownership suits people who want to vote, use Injective apps, take part in the BuyBack, trade at any hour or move tokens freely. Some investors may choose to hold both.
How to Trade INJC
INJC is traded just like any other U.S.-listed ETF, with dollars, through a brokerage account.
- Open or use a brokerage account that offers Nasdaq-listed ETFs. Availability depends on the broker, the account type and the country you live in.
- Search for the ticker INJC and check the fund's prospectus at canaryetfs.com/INJC for full details.
- Check the price before you trade. New funds can have bigger gaps between the bid and ask prices. A limit order lets you set the most you will pay.
- Hold the shares in your brokerage account. Whether INJC can go in an IRA or other retirement account is up to your broker.
There is no minimum investment beyond the price of one share, or less if your broker offers fractional shares. INJC trades from 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET on weekdays, plus any extended hours your broker supports. Because INJ keeps trading on weekends, INJC can open Monday at a noticeably different price from Friday's close.
Risks to Understand
INJC removes the work of holding and staking INJ, and it keeps the risks of the underlying asset.
- Price swings: INJ can move sharply in either direction, and INJC moves with it. Investors can lose some or all of what they put in.
- Staking risk: validators can be penalized for errors or outages, which would reduce the fund's INJ. Reward rates change over time and are not guaranteed.
- Weekend gaps: INJ trades every day, so news over a weekend shows up in INJC's price only when the market opens.
- Regulatory change: rules for crypto ETFs and for staking inside them are still developing in the U.S.
The full list of risk factors is in the INJC prospectus, which is worth reading before buying.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is INJC?
INJC is the ticker for the Canary Staked INJ ETF, a U.S.-listed exchange-traded fund that holds spot INJ and stakes most of it. It launched on November 5, 2026 on Nasdaq.
Does INJC pay dividends or staking payouts?
No. Staking rewards are added back into the fund, so each share represents more INJ over time instead of paying cash.
What staking yield does INJC earn?
The fund earns the staking rewards Injective's network pays. Injective's staking reward rate was about 7% a year in late October 2026, and it changes with network conditions.
Can I redeem INJC shares for INJ?
No. INJC shares are traded on the stock market for dollars, the same way as any other ETF.
Can INJC holders vote in Injective governance?
No. Governance votes come from staked INJ held onchain, and INJC shareholders do not hold the tokens themselves.
Can I hold INJC in an IRA?
Possibly. Eligibility for IRAs and other retirement accounts depends on your broker.
Why doesn't INJC's price match the price of INJ?
Each share has its own dollar price, set by the fund's starting share value and its INJ per share. Compare percentage moves instead of price tags.
The Bottom Line
INJC is a milestone for Injective. A network built from day one for finance now has an ETF that tracks its native asset trading on Nasdaq. Available in the same brokerage accounts where millions of people already hold stocks and ETFs. Investors, advisors and institutions that had no easy way to own INJ can now reach it, staking included, through a single ticker.
The launch also shows how far Injective's work with regulated finance has come. Regulated futures, an SEC-registered transfer agent and now a staked ETF give traditional finance several ways to engage with Injective. As more of the financial system moves onchain, INJC gives a new wave of investors a simple way to be part of it.
This article is sponsored content brought to you by Injective. It is for informational purposes only and is not investment, tax or legal advice, or an offer to buy or sell any security. Read the INJC prospectus, including its risk factors, before investing.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs bought nearly twice what miners produced in Q3—but $430 million left on Thursday
articles.text:
Quick Take
- Q3 Bitcoin ETF accumulation exceeded mining, but two buying windows accounted for 91% of the quarter’s inflows.
- Older-holder balances fell by 248,000 BTC in Q3, a net cohort change that does not measure executed sales.
- ETF outflows on Nov. 5 show why persistent fund buying matters more than a quarterly comparison with mining.
US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows totaled $430 million on Nov. 5, according to Farside Investors.
Bitcoin's ETF buyers added 79,800 BTC in the third quarter, against 41,300 BTC newly mined, according to 21Shares' Nov. 2 report. The comparison supports the scarcity argument, but offers limited reassurance about demand today: most of that buying arrived in two short windows, while older-holder balances fell by much more.
For Bitcoin holders assessing a supply squeeze, the unresolved question is whether fund demand persists between those buying bursts. New issuance is only one part of the picture. Coins already held by existing investors can also move, so purchases exceeding mining output do not establish how much supply buyers must absorb at a given price.
The 21Shares figures cover Q3 through Sept. 30. Aug. 17-27 and Sept. 21-25 accounted for 91% of ETF inflows measured in Bitcoin.
The same report recorded a 248,000 BTC reduction in long-term-holder balances during Q3. That larger change puts existing holdings alongside issuance in the scarcity discussion. However, it is a net balance decline, not a measured total of executed market sales.
ETF ownership and age-based holder classifications also are not established as mutually exclusive. Subtracting the balance decline from ETF purchases, or adding it to issuance as a separate block of selling, would imply an accounting precision the figures do not provide.
Glassnode's long-term-holder position metric offers a more recent directional check. Its public page showed approximately negative 151,885 BTC in a 10:39 UTC capture on Nov. 6, labeled “24 hours ago.” That relative label does not establish a particular trading session.
The metric measures the rolling 30-day change in the cohort's supply. Coins mature into the long-term group as they age, while spending moves supply out. A negative reading means spending outweighs maturation, rather than that the displayed amount was sold during one day.
Glassnode classifies holders using an entity's averaged purchasing date, with gradual weighting centered on 155 days, and excludes exchange-wallet supply. The reading therefore describes a particular cohort, rather than all potential sellers. Its rolling window also differs from Q3, preventing a direct claim that distribution has accelerated or slowed.
Bitcoin ETF outflows shift the demand test
The more persuasive recovery signal would be repeated ETF inflows alongside slower net distribution from older holders. Persistent redemptions with continued distribution would weaken the case.

articles.title: Bank of England raises rates to 4% as it forecasts inflation near 5% next year
articles.text:
Quick Take
- The Bank of England raised rates 25 basis points to 4%, citing energy inflation and stronger activity.
- Higher sterling borrowing costs could squeeze Bitcoin allocations; the IMF’s evidence concerns historical US tightening.
- Lower energy prices with easing rate expectations, or resilient Bitcoin demand, would weaken the proposed bearish allocation channel.
The Bank of England raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 4% on Nov. 5 as a prolonged energy shock increased its inflation concerns. The move highlights a potential source of pressure on Bitcoin investors exposed to sterling borrowing. Bank of England decision
Eight policymakers backed the increase, while Catherine Mann preferred a larger, 50-basis-point move to 4.25%. The Bank projected UK consumer-price inflation around 5% in the second quarter of 2027, following September's 3.5% reading. The median in the Bank's Market Participants Survey already expected a 4% rate in November, which limits the case for treating the announcement as a fresh market shock.
The decision came despite limited evidence so far that the energy shock was spreading into broader wage and price-setting. Policymakers judged the pressure building in the economy sufficient to act, with stronger-than-expected activity adding to the case. That leaves persistence, including firms passing on costs and workers seeking higher pay, central to the next policy decisions. November minutes
The Bank of England’s tightening meets a global asset
UK borrowing costs were already rising. Forward market interest rates were feeding into rates faced by some households and firms, and benchmark two-year mortgage rates had risen nearly 50 basis points since the beginning of September. Business lending growth remained strong, showing that financing pressures were uneven. UK borrowing conditions
For investors exposed to sterling borrowing, higher financing costs could leave less room for Bitcoin positions. A broader reduction in willingness to take risk could also curb allocations.
Historical research supports the risk-taking mechanism. An IMF working paper published in August 2023 found that US Federal Reserve tightening reduced an aggregate crypto price factor through that channel. The factor's increasing correlation with equities coincided with institutional investors entering crypto. The finding concerns historical US policy and aggregate crypto prices, which limits its application to this UK decision. IMF working paper
The distinction matters for dollar funding. The Bank of England sets UK Bank Rate. Establishing a change in current US dollar financing conditions would require separate evidence, as would attributing a Bitcoin price move to this announcement.
The inflation outlook is conditional. The near-term projection used energy prices averaged over the 15 UK working days ending Oct. 27. The projected later decline in direct energy contributions relied partly on downward-sloping futures prices and base effects, as earlier price increases drop out of annual comparisons.
Lower energy prices accompanied by easing rate expectations would weaken the proposed bearish allocation channel. So would Bitcoin demand that withstands tighter financing conditions. The Bank itself kept future policy dependent on incoming evidence, making wages, firms' pricing behavior and demand important tests of how far the energy shock travels. Bank of England outlook

articles.title: Nhận định Hải Phòng vs SLNA, 18h00 ngày 7/11: Chủ ‘cứng cựa’ gặp khách ‘rắn mặt’
articles.text:
Nhận định trước trận Hải Phòng vs SLNA
Hải Phòng bước vào vòng 7 với tinh thần được cải thiện sau chiến thắng 1-0 trước Đồng Nai. Ba điểm giành được ở vòng đấu gần nhất không chỉ giúp đội bóng đất Cảng có thêm sự tự tin mà còn đưa họ lên vị trí thứ 6 trên bảng xếp hạng với 9 điểm sau 6 trận. Đây là kết quả tương đối tích cực trong bối cảnh lực lượng của Hải Phòng có nhiều biến động trước mùa giải năm nay.
Dù vậy, thầy trò HLV Đặng Văn Thành vẫn chưa tạo được sự ổn định cần thiết. Những kết quả từ đầu mùa cho thấy Hải Phòng có khả năng chơi tốt và giành chiến thắng trước các đối thủ phù hợp, nhưng đội bóng đất Cảng vẫn cần cải thiện nhiều mặt nếu muốn cạnh tranh ở nhóm đầu. Trận tiếp SLNA trên sân Lạch Tray sẽ là phép thử đáng kể đối với tham vọng của đội chủ nhà.
Tuy nhiên, đội khách đang là một trong những tập thể có phong độ tốt nhất LPBank V.League 2026/27. Sau 6 vòng đấu, SLNA giành 3 chiến thắng, 3 trận hòa và chưa phải nhận thất bại nào, qua đó có được 12 điểm.
Thành tích này càng đáng ghi nhận khi đội bóng xứ Nghệ không sở hữu quá nhiều ngôi sao hay những bản hợp đồng đình đám. Thay vào đó, HLV Văn Sỹ Sơn đang xây dựng một tập thể có tính tổ chức cao, với nhiều cầu thủ trẻ trưởng thành từ chính lò đào tạo của CLB.
Ở vòng đấu gần nhất, SLNA đã cầm hòa đương kim vô địch Công an Hà Nội với tỷ số 1-1. Đặc biệt, đội bóng xứ Nghệ vẫn bảo toàn được một điểm dù gặp bất lợi về quân số trong giai đoạn cuối trận. Kết quả này cho thấy bản lĩnh và tinh thần tập thể của SLNA, đồng thời giúp họ có thêm sự tự tin trước chuyến hành quân đến Lạch Tray.
Phong độ, lịch sử đối đầu Hải Phòng vs SLNA
Lợi thế sân nhà là điểm tựa quan trọng của Hải Phòng. Sự cổ vũ cuồng nhiệt từ khán giả đất Cảng thường tạo ra bầu không khí đặc biệt tại Lạch Tray, giúp các cầu thủ chủ nhà duy trì cường độ thi đấu cao.
Với lối chơi giàu năng lượng, khả năng pressing và tổ chức tấn công trực diện, Hải Phòng có thể gây sức ép đáng kể lên hàng phòng ngự đối phương. Nếu giành chiến thắng, họ sẽ nâng tổng điểm mùa này lên con số 12 và san bằng thành tích hiện tại của SLNA.
Trên sân nhà, Hải Phòng đang có chuỗi 7 trận liên tiếp bất bại trước SLNA, bao gồm 4 chiến thắng và 3 trận hòa, kéo dài từ năm 2019 đến nay. Mới nhất là trận thắng 2-0 ở vòng 3 của V.League mùa trước. Dữ liệu ấy tuy không thể thay thế cho phong độ hiện tại, nhưng cũng sẽ là động lực lớn để đoàn quân của HLV Đặng Văn Thành tự tin bước vào trận đón tiếp đối thủ xứ Nghệ.
Trong khi đó, SLNA đang có phần nhỉnh hơn ở thành tích đối đầu trên mọi đấu trường gần đây. Họ đã thắng 2, hòa 4 và chỉ thua 1 trong 7 lần chạm trán Hải Phòng tính từ năm 2023 trở lại đây. Thành tích này cũng là cơ sở để đội khách tự tin dù phải thi đấu tại “chảo lửa” Lạch Tray.
Với tương quan hiện tại, đây nhiều khả năng sẽ là trận đấu cân bằng. Hải Phòng có thể chủ động đẩy cao đội hình để tìm kiếm bàn thắng, nhưng cần đặc biệt cảnh giác với khả năng phản công của SLNA. Trong khi đó, đội khách có lý do để duy trì cách chơi chắc chắn, tận dụng những khoảng trống khi đối phương dâng cao. Một kết quả hòa là kịch bản có thể xảy ra nếu cả hai đội đều duy trì được sự tập trung.
Thông tin lực lượng Hải Phòng vs SLNA
Hải Phòng có đầy đủ lực lượng cho cuộc tiếp đón SLNA. Đây là điều kiện thuận lợi để HLV Đặng Văn Thành lựa chọn đội hình xuất phát có tính ổn định, đặc biệt ở những vị trí quan trọng trong hệ thống phòng ngự và tổ chức tấn công.
Nguyễn Văn Toản nhiều khả năng tiếp tục bắt chính trong khung thành. Ở hàng phòng ngự, Nguyễn Ngọc Tú, Esteban Orozco và Nguyễn Quốc Anh là những lựa chọn đáng chú ý. Tuyến giữa với Nguyễn Vũ Tín, Hữu Sơn và Hồ Minh Dĩ cần đảm bảo khả năng tranh chấp, đồng thời hỗ trợ triển khai bóng lên phía trên.
Trên hàng công, Joel Tagueu, Aleksandar Makaric và Mpande là những nhân tố có thể tạo ra khác biệt. Khả năng di chuyển, tranh chấp và tận dụng cơ hội của các ngoại binh này sẽ ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến sức ép mà Hải Phòng tạo ra trước khung thành đối phương.
Ở phía đối diện, SLNA không có sự phục vụ của Lê Văn Quý do án treo giò. Sự vắng mặt này khiến HLV Văn Sỹ Sơn phải có điều chỉnh về nhân sự, nhưng đội bóng xứ Nghệ vẫn còn nhiều lựa chọn để duy trì sự cân bằng giữa các tuyến. Thủ môn Văn Bình dự kiến tiếp tục trấn giữ khung thành, trong khi những cầu thủ như Jairo, Nguyên Hoàng và Thanh Đức đảm nhiệm vai trò quan trọng ở hàng phòng ngự.
Ở tuyến giữa, Onoja và Khắc Ngọc là những nhân tố lợi hại nhất của đội khách. Nếu Khắc Ngọc có thể phát huy khả năng điều tiết nhịp độ, SLNA sẽ có thêm phương án kiểm soát thế trận và tổ chức tấn công. Trên hàng công, Trần Đức Vinh, Abdel Amine và Da Silva là những mối nguy lớn cho khung thành Hải Phòng nhờ tốc độ và khả năng phối hợp đang ngày càng ăn ý.
Đội hình dự kiến Hải Phòng vs SLNA
Hải Phòng: Văn Toản, Ngọc Tú, Esteban Orozco, Quốc Anh, Mạnh Dũng, Vũ Tín, Hữu Sơn, Minh Dĩ, Mpande, Tagueu, Makaric.
SLNA: Văn Bình; Thanh Đức, Nguyên Hoàng, Jairo, Bá Quyền; Quang Vinh, Onoja, Khắc Ngọc; Abdel-Amine Trần Đức Vinh, Xuân Đại, Luiz Guilherme.
Dự đoán: Hải Phòng 1-1 SLNA

articles.title: Bầu cử Mỹ: Ứng viên Dân chủ dù dừng tranh cử vẫn đánh bại đối thủ Cộng hòa
articles.text:
TPO - Một ứng viên đảng Dân chủ đã giành chiến thắng trước đối thủ đảng Cộng hòa tại khu vực bầu cử phía tây bang Iowa (Mỹ) trong cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ hôm 3/11, dù ông đã tạm dừng chiến dịch tranh cử từ hai tháng trước vì lý do sức khỏe.
Theo hãng tin AP, ông Eric Armstrong - một cựu giám đốc điều hành ngành đường sắt - đã đánh bại ứng cử viên đảng Cộng hòa Keith Jones với cách biệt khoảng 9 điểm phần trăm.
Nhờ chiến thắng này, ông Armstrong sẽ đảm nhận ghế Hạ nghị sĩ đại diện bang Iowa mà trước đó do Hạ nghị sĩ Dân chủ Josh Turek nắm giữ. Ông Turek đã giành chiến thắng trong cuộc đua vào Thượng viện Mỹ hôm 3/11.
Hai năm trước, cử tri tại khu vực này từng ủng hộ Tổng thống đảng Cộng hòa Donald Trump.
Ông Eric Armstrong. (Ảnh: The Times)
Chiến thắng của ông Armstrong khiến nhiều người bất ngờ, vì ông đã tuyên bố rút lui khỏi chiến dịch tranh cử từ tháng 9. Dù vậy, tên ông vẫn có trên lá phiếu.
“Vì hiện tại tôi cần ưu tiên cho sức khỏe và quá trình hồi phục, nên tôi quyết định dừng chiến dịch tranh cử của mình, có hiệu lực ngay lập tức”, ông viết ngày 7/9. “Đây là một quyết định vô cùng khó khăn, nhưng tôi biết đó là lựa chọn đúng đắn.”
“Khu vực bầu cử của chúng ta xứng đáng có một đại diện có thể dành 100% năng lượng cho cuộc đua này”, ông nói thêm. “Lúc này, tôi cần tập trung vào việc hồi phục để có thể tiếp tục phục vụ cộng đồng theo những cách khác trong tương lai”.
Trong cuộc phỏng vấn với tờ The New York Times vào sáng 4/11 sau khi giành chiến thắng, ông Armstrong khẳng định sẽ nỗ lực hết sức để “đại diện cho khu vực bầu cử của mình”.
“Tuy nhiên, tôi vẫn đang gặp phải các vấn đề về sức khỏe, đó là điều tôi đang phải đối mặt”, ông chia sẻ.
Chia sẻ trên Facebook ngày 5/11, ông Armstrong nói rằng ông cảm thấy tự hào về chiến thắng này và khẳng định sẽ “cởi mở, thẳng thắn về những bước tiếp theo”.
Đảng Dân chủ đã giành được những thắng lợi quan trọng trong các cuộc đua trên toàn quốc, giành quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện của Quốc hội và thay đổi cục diện tại các cơ quan lập pháp tiểu bang. Lần đầu tiên sau nhiều thập kỷ, đảng này đã giành được ghế thống đốc và một ghế Thượng viện tại Texas, đồng thời đạt được những chiến thắng đáng chú ý tại các tiểu bang vốn nghiêng về đảng Cộng hòa như Kansas, Nam Carolina và Florida.
Tại bang Iowa, ứng viên Dân chủ Josh Turek đã đánh bại đối thủ từ Đảng Cộng hòa trong cuộc đua vào Thượng viện, trong khi ứng viên đảng Dân chủ Rob Sand giành chiến thắng trong cuộc đua vào ghế thống đốc tiểu bang.

Vậy Bộ trưởng Chiến tranh Mỹ Pete Hegseth sẽ làm gì trước nguy cơ bị điều tra và luận tội trước Quốc hội và trước tin mới nhất là ông có thể bị Thống đốc Florida Ron DeSantis thay thế?
TPO - Làn sóng biểu tình mới đang lan rộng tại Pháp, với các cuộc đụng độ giữa người biểu tình và cảnh sát chống bạo động ở Lyon, trong khi hàng loạt thành phố khác cũng ghi nhận các cuộc tuần hành và đình công quy mô lớn.
TPO - Tổng thống Mỹ Donald Trump vừa ký sắc lệnh bảo tồn Phòng Bầu dục và Phòng Nội các như những di tích quốc gia. Đây là hành động chính thức đầu tiên của ông sau khi đảng Cộng hòa hứng chịu thất bại nặng nề trong cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ hôm 3/11.
TPO - Tổng thống Paraguay Santiago Pena đã từ chức sau khi sự sụp đổ của ngân hàng kỹ thuật số Ueno gây ra một cuộc khủng hoảng chính trị và tài chính, khiến hàng triệu tài khoản bị phong tỏa và làm lung lay niềm tin của các nhà đầu tư vào một trong những nền kinh tế ổn định nhất Nam Mỹ.

articles.title: Giải mã "kho báu" địa chất hơn 400 triệu năm tuổi ở Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng
articles.text:
Hơn hai thập niên kể từ ngày được UNESCO công nhận là Di sản thiên nhiên thế giới, Vườn quốc gia Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng ở Quảng Trị không chỉ nổi tiếng bởi cảnh quan kỳ vĩ mà còn được xem như một "bảo tàng địa chất" khổng lồ. Nơi đây lưu giữ những giá trị đặc biệt về địa chất, địa mạo và đa dạng sinh học, mở ra nhiều hướng nghiên cứu khoa học về lịch sử hình thành Trái đất.
Kỳ quan địa chất hơn 400 triệu năm tuổi
Từ đỉnh U Bò nhìn xuống, những dãy núi đá vôi trùng điệp phủ kín màu xanh đại ngàn. Ít ai hình dung bên dưới cảnh quan ấy là một kho tư liệu tự nhiên khổng lồ, được kiến tạo qua hàng trăm triệu năm.
Theo các nhà khoa học, hệ thống núi đá vôi Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng hình thành từ hơn 400 triệu năm trước, thuộc nhóm vùng karst cổ nhất châu Á. Quá trình kiến tạo địa chất lâu dài đã tạo nên địa hình karst đặc trưng với những khối núi đá vôi đồ sộ, hàng trăm hang động, sông ngầm cùng các tầng trầm tích chứa nhiều dấu tích cổ sinh học.
Các lớp đá trầm tích xếp chồng lên nhau như những trang sử ghi lại quá trình biến đổi của vỏ trái đất. Trong lòng núi là những hóa thạch và dấu tích cổ xưa, giúp giới nghiên cứu tìm hiểu lịch sử địa chất, khí hậu cũng như sự xuất hiện và tiến hóa của sự sống qua nhiều thời kỳ.
Với diện tích hơn 123.000ha, phần lớn là địa hình karst, Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng được xem là hiện trường thực địa quý giá của địa chất học, cổ sinh học và sinh thái học. Những giá trị nổi bật về địa chất, địa mạo, đa dạng sinh học và cảnh quan đã giúp khu di sản hai lần được UNESCO ghi danh vào năm 2003 và 2015.
Không chỉ có những khối đá hàng trăm triệu năm tuổi, khu rừng nguyên sinh còn lưu giữ nhiều báu vật sinh học. Đáng chú ý là quần thể bách xanh núi đá quý hiếm, với những cây cổ thụ có tuổi đời trên 500 năm, sinh trưởng trên các vách đá vôi ở độ cao gần 700m so với mực nước biển.
Theo Ban Quản lý vườn quốc gia Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng, quần thể bách xanh có diện tích khoảng 5.000ha, với nhiều cây cao hơn 30m, đường kính thân vượt 2m. Đây là một trong những quần thể bách xanh núi đá có giá trị đặc biệt, được phát hiện cách đây khoảng 20 năm.
Đặc biệt, trong sinh cảnh khắc nghiệt trên những vách đá này, còn có sự hiện diện của ba loài lan quý hiếm gồm: lan hài xanh, lan hài đốm và lan hài xoắn. Cả ba đều nằm trong Sách đỏ quốc tế, thuộc nhóm có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng.
Những giá trị ấy khiến Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng không đơn thuần là điểm đến du lịch, mà còn là nơi các nhà khoa học tìm đến để giải mã những bí ẩn của tự nhiên. Mỗi lớp đá, cánh rừng hay hang động đều chứa đựng những thông tin quý giá về lịch sử hình thành và phát triển của hành tinh.
Giải mã "vương quốc ngầm", giữ báu vật di sản
Nếu trên mặt đất là những dãy núi đá vôi trùng điệp và rừng nguyên sinh, bên dưới lòng đất Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng lại mở ra một thế giới khác với hệ thống hang động, sông ngầm đan xen phức tạp.
Đến nay, các nhà thám hiểm đã khảo sát được 473 hang động, với tổng chiều dài khảo sát đạt trên 259km. Trong 5 năm gần đây, hàng chục hang động và nhánh sông ngầm mới tiếp tục được phát hiện, bổ sung thêm khoảng 30km vào bản đồ hang động của khu vực.
Đáng chú ý, những cuộc khảo sát không chỉ mở rộng hiểu biết về địa hình ngầm mà còn phát hiện thêm nhiều loài động, thực vật mới. Tổng số loài mới được ghi nhận tại khu vực đã lên đến 48 loài, cho thấy tiềm năng nghiên cứu khoa học vẫn còn rất lớn.
Trong các chuyến khảo sát gần đây, nhóm chuyên gia hang động Hoàng gia Anh tiếp tục phát hiện những nhánh hang mới kết nối khu vực hang Va, hang Nước Nút và Sơn Đoòng. Sau hơn 30 năm gắn bó với vùng karst này, các chuyên gia vẫn liên tục ghi nhận những điều mới mẻ trong lòng di sản.
Bên trong các hang động là những khối thạch nhũ khổng lồ, hồ nước ngầm trong vắt cùng nhiều sinh vật thích nghi với môi trường thiếu ánh sáng. Cá không mắt, bọ cạp, tắc kè đá, tôm phát quang, dơi và các loài vi sinh vật tạo nên hệ sinh thái đặc biệt trong lòng núi.
Riêng hang Sơn Đoòng còn có một hệ sinh thái gần như tách biệt. Tại những hố sụt, ánh sáng mặt trời chiếu xuống tạo điều kiện cho rừng cây phát triển giữa lòng hang, trở thành nơi sinh sống của nhiều loài chim, thằn lằn và sinh vật khác.
Tuy nhiên, những giá trị đặc biệt của di sản cũng đang đối mặt với nhiều thách thức. Bên cạnh tác động của biến đổi khí hậu và các quá trình xói mòn tự nhiên, tình trạng xâm nhập rừng, khai thác trái phép tài nguyên cũng đặt ra áp lực trong công tác bảo tồn.
Ông Phạm Văn Tân, Giám đốc Trung tâm Bảo vệ rừng và di sản thế giới cho biết, địa bàn quản lý rộng hơn 123.000ha, địa hình hiểm trở khiến việc kiểm soát, tuần tra không dễ dàng. Mỗi ngày, vẫn có người vào rừng, trong đó có trường hợp tìm kiếm lan, gỗ hoặc tự ý khám phá các khu vực rừng nguyên sinh.
Để tăng hiệu quả quản lý, cùng với lực lượng tuần tra trực tiếp, công tác bảo vệ di sản đang được đẩy mạnh bằng công nghệ. Ông Phạm Hồng Thái, Giám đốc Ban Quản lý vườn quốc gia Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng cho biết, đơn vị đang xây dựng cơ sở dữ liệu số về địa chất, sinh học, hang động và tri thức bản địa.
Các công nghệ như ảnh viễn thám, hệ thống thông tin địa lý (GIS), trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) và cảm biến cảnh báo sớm được tích hợp nhằm phục vụ giám sát rừng, phát hiện nguy cơ xâm hại và hỗ trợ nghiên cứu.
Dù vậy, theo ông Thái, công nghệ chỉ là một phần của giải pháp. Muốn bảo tồn di sản lâu dài phải có sự tham gia của cộng đồng dân cư vùng đệm. Ban Quản lý đang phối hợp với các địa phương đưa nội dung giáo dục bảo tồn vào trường học, đồng thời hỗ trợ người dân phát triển sinh kế bền vững như trồng dược liệu dưới tán rừng, du lịch cộng đồng và nông nghiệp hữu cơ.
"Phong Nha - Kẻ Bàng là kỳ quan, nhưng cũng là một sinh thể sống cần được bảo vệ từng ngày. Bảo tồn không thể làm một mình, mà cần người dân cùng chung tay, đồng hành và che chở. Giữ rừng di sản không chỉ là giữ một danh hiệu, mà còn là giữ lấy tương lai của chính mình", ông Thái chia sẻ.
Một nghiên cứu gần đây của các nhà khoa học thuộc nhiều viện nghiên cứu ở Việt Nam ghi nhận 80 loài chân khớp hình nhện tại khu vực Sơn Đoòng, trong đó có 10 loài mới và 13 loài chưa được định danh. Những phát hiện này cho thấy thế giới sinh vật dưới lòng đất vẫn còn nhiều bí ẩn chờ được khám phá.
